Known limitation, recorded and not fixed: '(in millions, except for percentages and average rates)' and any other exception clause still exclude the table
probe.py.currency_name_plural_pre_pr_review_9dcb4: OTHER_NAME_WORD = (?:OTHER_NAMES)s?\b is the single whole-word currency-name fragment, used by CURRENCY_NAME, so 'All amounts are in South African rands' and 'Polish zlotys' are declarations (E2); the other uses are in currency_name_word_pre_pr_review_cea94e09
probe.py.caption_currency_word_boundary_pre_pr_re: CONTEXT_CURRENCY uses OTHER_NAME_WORD in both places, so 'thousands of franchised restaurants' and 'millions of European customers' no longer name a currency while '(in millions of euros)' still does (E3)
probe.py.per_share_unit_scope_pre_pr_review_cea94: PER_SHARE_UNIT keeps 'except' lenient ('except' up to 40 characters before 'per [basic|diluted] [common] share', no parenthesis between) but 'excluding' and 'other than' match only when whitespace and then 'per [basic|diluted] [common] share' follow at once, so 'Net Income Excluding Special Items, Per Share' and 'Income other than discontinued operations, per share' keep their exclusion in captions and headers. One compiled pattern. The except form first tries the plain 'per share' match (the 9dcb441d behaviour) and only then a basic, diluted or common qualified one, so a unit line naming a qualified per-share item before a plain one ('except per diluted share data and per share amounts') is still ignored whole
probe.py.unit_line_per_share_pre_pr_review_cea94e: unit_line first removes an 'except ...' clause (up to the next parenthesis) and then PER_SHARE_UNIT matches, so '(In millions, excluding per share data)', '(In millions, other than per share data)' and '(In millions, except per share data and percentages)' are unit lines and titled() joins the title above them (a 'Non-GAAP Results' title over such a line excludes the table, 'Financial Results' does not). Known limitations, recorded and not fixed: (b) titled() uses the nearest text block, so a prose paragraph between a Non-GAAP, Core, Adjusted or Outlook title and its table keeps the title from the exclusion check (pre-existing; at 9dcb441d some such tables were excluded only through false per-share or caption-currency hits); (c) '(… except per share and per diluted share data)' and '(… except per basic share and per diluted share data)' still exclude a GAAP table (unchanged since 9dcb441d)
probe.py.currency_name_word_pre_pr_review_cea94e0: OTHER_CURRENCY_WORDS, TRAILING_CURRENCY and LEADING_CURRENCY use OTHER_NAME_WORD, each keeping its own leading boundary and structure; OTHER_NAMES is now referenced only inside OTHER_NAME_WORD, so a header 'South African rands' and a row label 'Net income (Polish zlotys)' are currency_mismatch. Known limitation, recorded and not fixed: (a) the Polish genitive plural 'zlotych' and the Serbian 'dinara' and 'dinari', like 'zlotych', no longer match in caption unit phrases

access_check.rule: A GET of https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/full-index/ with the declared user agent; only the status is kept, outside the probe and its journals. It runs once before the freeze, once right before --run and once before acknowledging any 403 or 429. Acknowledge only when that GET returns 200 and it is the attempt's first acknowledged 403 or 429; otherwise stop and re-plan. The probe can never request this URL itself (outside the allowed prefix). An acknowledged 403 is permanent for its URL and its event stays in the denominators as unavailable.
